zh-CN.title: 群聊默认跟随你的聊天背景
items: 未设置群背景时，每位成员都会看到自己的个人聊天背景
群主设置系统背景后，成员仍可选择继续使用自己的背景

en.title: Group chats now follow your background by default
items: When no group background is set, every member sees their own personal chat background
After an owner selects a system background, members can still choose to keep their own
